description: Multi-agent retail operations assistant. Handles inventory queries, sales trend analysis, purchase order creation, and durable replenishment workflows with human-in-the-loop approval.

capabilities.name: inventory_query
capabilities.description: Query product inventory levels by name or ID.

capabilities.name: sales_trend_analysis
capabilities.description: Summarize monthly sales trends by product category.

capabilities.name: reorder_recommendation
capabilities.description: Compute a data-backed reorder recommendation for a product.

capabilities.name: replenishment_workflow
capabilities.description: Initiate a durable replenishment workflow with optional human-in-the-loop approval. Returns a workflow_id for async tracking.

capabilities.name: purchase_order_status
capabilities.description: Retrieve the status of an existing purchase order or workflow.
